name: remote-cli-agents
description: Web-based remote control for CLI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev:shared" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:dual: concurrently -n dev,prod -c blue,green "npm run dev" "npm run start:prod:local"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/web && npm run postbuild
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const s=p.join('packages','web','dist');const d=p.join('packages','server','web');fs.cpSync(s,d,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('Web client copied to server/web/')"
